title: PR #241: docs(architecture): align ATC-SMM with ShivaCore memory contracts
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Summary

Revises the ATC-SMM architecture draft to inherit existing ShivaCore contracts rather than inventing a parallel memory API or kernel model.

## Authority and SSOT

- `atc-shivacore` is the ShivaCore kernel architecture/specification authority.
- Canonical active implementation remains `globus-os/modules/atc-shivacore/kernel/`.
- `a-townchain-ecosystem` owns cross-repository mapping and integration evidence.
- `atc-standards` retains ecosystem-wide standards registry and governance.
- No second kernel, allocator, syscall ABI or memory implementation is introduced.

## ShivaCore contracts reconciled

Inspected at `atc-shivacore` baseline `3b56253b39bdc6cbf719ed9a2a21461d73b8fc34`:

- `SHIVA-KERNEL-REUSE-001` — OS-neutral kernel/TCB boundary.
- `SHIVA-HAL-001` — architecture-specific page-table, CPU and synchronization mechanisms remain behind HAL.
- `SHIVA-ABI-001` — explicit capabilities, pointer/length validation, no ambient authority, versioned ABI.
- `SHIVA-BOOT-001` — boot handoff and kernel initialization boundary.
- `SC-001-BOOT_MEMORY.md` (FROZEN) — BootInfo, physical memory classification, Untyped/Retype, 4 KiB frames, Initial Task.
- `SC-005-CAPABILITY_SYSTEM.md` (FROZEN) — typed object rights, monotonic derivation and revocation.
- `SC-007-ADDRESSSPACE_MEMORY.md` (FROZEN) — AddressSpace MAP + Frame GRANT, mapping-right subset, W^X, kernel-owned page tables, synchronous unmap/TLB semantics.
- `SHIVA-GLOBUS-INTEGRATION-001` (DRAFT) — ShivaCore mechanism boundary vs GlobusOS service policy.

## Corrections made

1. Clarifies ShivaCore specification authority vs GlobusOS implementation SSOT.
2. Replaces generic physical-frame allocator language with SC-001 Untyped/Retype authority and SC-007 mapping semantics.
3. Removes the invented generic `MemoryRights` model; distinguishes Frame rights from AddressSpace rights.
4. Makes W^X an inherited frozen SC-007 policy; ATC-SMM cannot create runtime exceptions.
5. Records the `memory_manager.rs` generic `READ|WRITE|EXEC|DELEGATE` capability as a spec-conformance residual, without claiming this proves executable hardware mappings.
6. Records `UserspaceBump` and the current kernel-heap bridge as interim behavior, not conformant process mapping.
7. Records the `globus-memory` paging/frame modules as models/abstractions, not a second hardware authority.
8. Records the SC-001 vs SHIVA-BOOT boot-contract discrepancy: SC-001 defines Limine B0–B5 and explicitly says L0–L10 is not real hardware boot evidence. Owner/versioned resolution remains required.
9. Reuses existing `FN-KERNEL-001` and `FN-VMM-001`; no duplicate delivery IDs.
10. Refines PR #89/#108 descriptions based on inspected metadata and patch content.

## Evidence and limits

- ShivaCore specification baseline and individual blob SHAs are recorded in the document.
- GlobusOS `memory_manager.rs` inspected at blob `6d1d8ec948b3d3d0d683e1a0e92d9c77ee2fbfaa`.
- PR #89 remains Draft; remote TLB shootdown/SMP integration remain residuals.
- PR #108 is non-draft; its current patch changes the memory-manager compile-time assertion, not the broad capability rights.
- This PR changes documentation only. No kernel implementation, frozen ShivaCore spec, runtime behavior or standards registry was modified.
- No tests, CI, boot, E2E or production-readiness claim is made by this documentation update. Empty status-check response is not a pass.
- ATC-SMM remains DRAFT pending owner review. No standard ID allocated and no normative approval claimed.

## Review required

1. ShivaCore owner review of inherited SC-001/SC-005/SC-007 constraints and the boot-contract discrepancy.
2. Confirm the `memory_manager.rs` interim path and the intended migration/conformance plan.
3. Confirm PR #89 exact-head TLB/SMP evidence and coordinate with PR #108.
4. Approve any future normative change through the ShivaCore SC-DEC/SC-ARCH process and the applicable standards registry workflow.

## Kernel memory conformance audit (2026-11-02)

Read-only source audit added to the architecture draft (MEM-09 through MEM-18). No kernel code was modified.

Key blockers:
- Current boot source uses bootloader_api, while frozen SC-001 defines Limine B0-B5 and explicitly says L0-L10 is not real device boot evidence.
- BootInfo frame allocator does not implement SC-001 Untyped/Retype ownership or reclaim.
- Kernel heap mapping sets PRESENT|WRITABLE without NO_EXECUTE: W^X review is HIGH priority.
- MemorySubsystem, ProcessManager and VFS construct independent CapabilityTable instances.
- Capability implementation is a flat PID-indexed table with generic 8-bit rights, not frozen SC-005 CSpace/CNode and typed object-right model.
- VMM contains hardware page-table mutation code, but real-boot wiring is not established; mapping APIs are not capability-gated and unmap/reclaim does not complete SC-007 TLB shootdown.
- Page-fault IDT handler logs and returns; SC-007 suspend/endpoint-notification/resume protocol is not implemented in that path.
- PR #89 exact head has a failed rust check and cancelled BIOS/UEFI smoke checks. PR #108 exact head has a failed rust check.
- PR #241 exact head checks are currently queued/in progress; no CI pass is claimed.

Disposition: kernel memory implementation remains BLOCKED for SC-001/SC-005/SC-007 conformance. Reuse FN-KERNEL-001 and FN-VMM-001. No duplicate allocator, capability table, VMM or fault subsystem is authorized.
